title: POVODEŇ (Flood): a pixel-art serious game for inter-municipal flood cooperation
description: A browser-based pixel-art serious game for mayors and municipal crisis staff on a shared river. Players prepare their town for ten flood seasons, trade with six computer-controlled neighbours and are scored twice: on re-election prospects and on the regional outcome. Includes a headless balance simulator, characterization tests and balance reports. Developed under the RUR project (Region to University, University to Region) at Jan Evangelista Purkyně University, Ústí nad Labem.
